symbols.title: Target Tickers / Symbols
symbols.description: List of tickers, indices, commodities, currencies, or crypto symbols to analyze cycles for (e.g. SPY, QQQ, BTC-USD, GC=F, EURUSD=X, AAPL, NVDA).

cycleTemplate.title: Cycle Profile / Template
cycleTemplate.description: Select predefined institutional cycle templates or multi-cycle composite overlay.
enumTitles: All Cycles Composite Overlay (Stock 18Y, Comm 16Y, Crypto 4Y, Forex 8Y)
Stock Market Cycles (18-Year Real Estate / Business Cycle)

forecastHorizonMonths.title: Forecast Horizon (Months)
forecastHorizonMonths.description: Number of months into the future to project analog cycles and statistical ARIMA models (e.g. 36 months = 3 years).

yearsBack.title: Historical Lookback (Years)
yearsBack.description: Number of historical years of market data to fetch for phase extraction and analog matching.

enableArimaForecasts.title: Include ARIMA / SARIMAX Forecasts
enableArimaForecasts.description: Enable fitting ARMA, ARIMA, and seasonal SARIMA statistical models on monthly log prices.

enableSpectralFFT.title: Include Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) Harmonics
enableSpectralFFT.description: Perform power spectral density (PSD) decomposition to detect dominant periodic cycles.

includeHistoricalLedger.title: Include Historical Cycle Phases Ledger
includeHistoricalLedger.description: Include complete table of past Bullish/Bearish phases with start/end prices, % returns, drawdowns, and accuracy.

includeTimeSeries.title: Include Monthly Time Series & Waves
includeTimeSeries.description: Include monthly historical price and composite wave time series arrays.
